quotes.text: Trying the Word of God By Virginia H. Pearce First Counselor in the Young Women General Presidency Please turn in the Book of Mormon to Alma, chapter 31. The prophet Alma went to the land of Antionum to teach the Zoramite people. Many of the Zoramites desired to worship God but were confused and discouraged.
